args.question: The platform doesn't recognize a service named "payments" (deployments and incidents lists are empty, so I can't infer the exact name). What is the exact service name for the affected payments service (e.g., "payments-api", "payment-service")?

trace.question: The platform doesn't recognize a service named "payments" (deployments and incidents lists are empty, so I can't infer the exact name). What is the exact service name for the affected payments service (e.g., "payments-api", "payment-service")?

trace.message: It's payments-worker - the API errors are downstream of the worker.

args.title: payments-worker v3.4.0 causing payment errors
args.summary: This morning's deploy of payments-worker v3.4.0 is unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate, causing downstream payments API errors. Rolling back to the last healthy version, v3.3.0. On-call paged for root-cause analysis of the v3.4.0 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Identified the issue**: The service is named `payments-worker` (not "payments") — the API errors were downstream of the worker. This morning's release **v3.4.0** was unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an **18% error rate**.
- **Rolled back**: Rolled `payments-worker` back to **v3.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions.
- **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy with an error rate down to **0.2%**.
- **Opened SEV2 incident**: INC-0001 is open for the v3.4.0 regression and the on-call engineer has been paged to investigate root cause.

Note: v3.4.0 is still in the deployment history as unhealthy, so re-releasing it later will require change-manager approval once root cause is fixed.
